newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June ethylene output rises 10 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June ethylene output rises 10 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's ethylene production totalled 604,000 tonnes in June, up by 10 percent from a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
MITI attributed the increase to the fact that only one ethylene centre was closed for routine maintenance work last month, compared with three plants in June 1996.

Ethylene production in the first half of 1997 grew 5.9 percent from the same period a year ago to 3.7 million tonnes on the back of brisk Asian demand for ethylene-derived products, a MITI official said.
Ethylene, which is manufactured from naphtha, is the building block of various petrochemical products.
